name: ionden-skills
description: Agent skills for people who run Claude Code or OpenAI Codex and want to spend fewer tokens. subagent-optimizer cuts what each Claude Code subagent or Codex custom agent costs to launch: a tight tool allowlist, a shorter prompt, a model and effort that fit the job, and none of the keys that make Codex skip an agent. skill-optimizer shortens a SKILL.md, so it costs fewer tokens each time it loads, without losing an instruction. writing-tests-that-can-fail is for everyday coding, in any language: tests that exercise real behaviour and fail on the bug they exist to catch.
